thread:
Asha (People Ops): Quick note 1: pushed a small policy tidy for the leave & training pages. It's mostly clarifications but introduces an exceptions workflow for region-specific leave terms. Link: https://handbook.redwood.ai/policy-tidy-2026 :sparkles:
Tom R: Nice. Does this affect the military/parental leave language we updated last year?
Asha (People Ops): No substantive change to entitlements. We reorganized sections (so easier to find local overrides) and added a manager-ack flow for any exceptions granted. See "Exceptions" card in the page.
Eva L: Manager-ack flow = managers click a confirm button? Any audit trail?
Asha (People Ops): Yes 3: managers confirm via the HR portal. Each exception request gets a ticket and an audit log entry (who approved, reason, start/end). Retention aligned with Legal's request (4 years).
Marta (EMEA HR): How should we handle country-specific parental pay where local law is more generous? Do managers still file an exception?
Asha (People Ops): If local law is more generous, no exception needed. We added a small decision tree in Appendix A. Only request exceptions when granting terms *more* generous than handbook baseline for payroll reasons.
Tom R: What's the timeline for this roll-out?
Asha (People Ops): Soft publish today. Mandatory micro-module for managers about the exceptions process + how to read the decision tree, due by 2026-06-01. Employees notified FYI; only managers need to complete.
learning-bot: Reminder set: "Exceptions Process (Managers)" 10-minute micro-module due by 2026-06-01 for users with role manager.
Eva L: Can we get a CSV of approved exceptions per country for audits?
Asha (People Ops): Yes 1: export available in the portal: Reports > Exceptions > export CSV. CLI: ```hr-report exceptions --since 2026-01-01 --format csv > exceptions-q2.csv```
Marta (EMEA HR): Accessibility: please ensure captions and German/Spanish transcripts for the manager module.
Asha (People Ops): Captions live; DE/ES transcripts uploaded by EOD tomorrow. Also adding a plain-text checklist for managers.
Tom R: What about contractors who have been converted recently? Any scope changes?
Asha (People Ops): Contractors not in scope for mandatory training. Converted hires who are now on payroll get standard onboarding tasks; any historical exceptions will be reviewed case-by-case.
Eva L: If a manager wants to grant a one-off travel top-up beyond stipend, is that an exception?
Asha (People Ops): Yes 1: exceptional reimbursements outside the stipend must go through the exception request so Payroll can flag tax treatment. We added an "expense vs stipend" checkbox in the form.
benefits-bot: Auto-notice: Any payroll-impacting exceptions will trigger a Payroll Ops review before funds are disbursed.
Tom R: Can a manager pre-approve multiple employees in a single ticket (bulk)? I have 12 people in same location needing the same accommodation.
Asha (People Ops): We built a bulk-request option for groups >5. Use the portal bulk upload CSV template (link on page). Marta, that should help EMEA rollouts.
Marta (EMEA HR): Bulk is perfect. Please add guidance about local documentation required for accommodations in Spain/France. I'll DM the text.
Asha (People Ops): Will add to Appendix B. Also dropping a 1-page manager cheat sheet here: https://redwood-assets.s3/peopleops/exception-cheatsheet-2026.pdf :paperclip:
Tom R: Thx 1: I'll schedule a 15-min team huddle to walk managers through it.
Eva L: Any enforcement if managers miss the deadline?
Asha (People Ops): We'll send weekly reminders, then escalate to HRBP for follow-up. No access locks.
learning-bot: Completion tracking live in Manager Dashboard. Export example: `peopleops-cli export --type exceptions-training --since 2026-05-01 --format csv`
Marta (EMEA HR): Thanks 1: I'll run the bulk test next week and report any localization tweaks.
Asha (People Ops): Closing loop 1: final reminder one week before due date. Ping me if you want the editable slide deck for team syncs. :white_check_mark:
